methods.name: Peer-Median

methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Alef Aeronautics is a Series A-stage transportation company that has raised $30M+ to date. The broader Transportation sector includes six private peers tracked in comparable analyses—among them Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, and REGENT Craft—though no public comparables exist in this segment. The narrow peer set for same-stage and adjacent-stage Transportation companies is insufficient (fewer than three datapoints) to support a reliable peer-median valuation.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using the $30M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $60M. This method anchors to observed capital deployment and empirical stage-to-stage expansion patterns.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $51M (low) to $69M (high), with a median of $60M. This range reflects the single applicable methodology and carries meaningful uncertainty around both the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific subsector and the absence of direct peer-comparable transaction data. Investors should note that validation would require either identification of closer Transportation-sector peers at similar stages or direct precedent transactions within aerospace and advanced transportation infrastructure.
